charter.section: ## 12. Increment ceiling (planning only - proposed, not begun - no increment is authorized)

binding.reason: Optional surface requires explicit operator direction; none was given at B5-I6 and none is given here.

entries.observable_on_rejection: Creation of test_b5_i7_web_view.py or any web surface during B5-I7 is a boundary violation visible in the diff.
entries.requirement: Charter increment I-7 (loopback web view) is NOT B5-I7 work; B5-I7 creates no web view and never creates test_b5_i7_web_view.py.
entries.source: charter §12 row I-7; B5-I6 gap contract §5; contract §4.1, §20

binding.reason: Plan §7 assigns usability and the independent audit to B5-I8.

entries.observable_on_rejection: B5-I7 executing or claiming usability evidence pulls a B5-I8 obligation into scope.
entries.requirement: Accessibility/usability protocol and results (gate G16, C5.S3) are not B5-I7 work.
entries.source: plan §7 row B5-I8; charter §11 G16; contract §4.2

binding.planned_node: B5-I9 factory-gate artifact (name fixed by the B5-I9 P0)
binding.reason: Plan §7 assigns the factory gate and B6 extraction contract to B5-I9; extraction scope is operator-ratified.

entries.observable_on_rejection: Any extraction or SDK artifact authored in B5-I7 pulls a B5-I9 obligation into scope.
entries.requirement: Factory corrections, reusable-extraction scope and the B6 contract (C5.S5) are not B5-I7 work.
entries.source: plan §6 C5.S5; plan §7 row B5-I9; contract §4.2

entries.observable_on_rejection: A cited 40-hex SHA that git cannot resolve fails the node.
entries.requirement: No predicted commit SHA may be written as fact; a SHA enters the record only after the object exists.
entries.source: contract §22; B5-I6 X1 lessons (ledger §17.12-§17.13, corrected audit 8.75/10)

entries.observable_on_rejection: An id absent from the raw artifact set fails the node.
entries.requirement: No run, check or artifact id may be recorded before that id exists.
entries.source: contract §22; B5-I6 X1 lessons (ledger §17.12-§17.13, corrected audit 8.75/10)

entries.observable_on_rejection: An evidence JSON without parser provenance from raw output fails the node.
entries.requirement: No manually authored JSON may be called execution evidence.
entries.source: contract §22; B5-I6 X1 lessons (ledger §17.12-§17.13, corrected audit 8.75/10)

entries.observable_on_rejection: A planned total labelled OBSERVED fails the node.
entries.requirement: Planned totals are labelled EXPECTED, never OBSERVED.
entries.source: contract §22; B5-I6 X1 lessons (ledger §17.12-§17.13, corrected audit 8.75/10)

entries.observable_on_rejection: An observed total with no parsed raw source fails the node.
entries.requirement: Observed totals may enter the ledger only after parsing raw artifacts.
entries.source: contract §22; B5-I6 X1 lessons (ledger §17.12-§17.13, corrected audit 8.75/10)

entries.observable_on_rejection: A success claim lacking head SHA and tree identity fails the node.
entries.requirement: A green badge is not evidence without SHA and tree binding.
entries.source: contract §22; B5-I6 X1 lessons (ledger §17.12-§17.13, corrected audit 8.75/10)

entries.observable_on_rejection: A regression-absence claim based only on new nodes fails the node.
entries.requirement: New-test-only execution cannot prove regression absence.
entries.source: contract §22; B5-I6 X1 lessons (ledger §17.12-§17.13, corrected audit 8.75/10)

entries.observable_on_rejection: A zero or below-floor common population fails the node.
entries.requirement: Common regression populations must be nonzero and meet the frozen floor.
entries.source: contract §22; B5-I6 X1 lessons (ledger §17.12-§17.13, corrected audit 8.75/10)

entries.observable_on_rejection: A manifest row whose recomputed sha256/size differs fails the node.
entries.requirement: Manifest claims require independently recomputed hash and size.
entries.source: contract §22; B5-I6 X1 lessons (ledger §17.12-§17.13, corrected audit 8.75/10)

entries.observable_on_rejection: A mutation never observed red, or a tree not restored byte-identically, fails the node.
entries.requirement: Mutation claims require actual discriminating failures and pristine restoration.
entries.source: contract §22; B5-I6 X1 lessons (ledger §17.12-§17.13, corrected audit 8.75/10)

entries.observable_on_rejection: A cleanup claim without a machine-readable residual listing fails the node.
entries.requirement: Cleanup claims require machine-readable residual-state proof.
entries.source: contract §22; B5-I6 X1 lessons (ledger §17.12-§17.13, corrected audit 8.75/10)

entries.observable_on_rejection: A record that erases the B5-I6 X1 process defects fails the node.
entries.requirement: Historical process defects remain visible after technical repair.
entries.source: contract §22; B5-I6 X1 lessons (ledger §17.12-§17.13, corrected audit 8.75/10)

entries.observable_on_rejection: The phrase asserting independent review of a same-agent audit fails the node.
entries.requirement: A same-agent audit must never be labeled organizationally independent.
entries.source: contract §22; B5-I6 X1 lessons (ledger §17.12-§17.13, corrected audit 8.75/10)

entries.observable_on_rejection: A ratification statement while any gate is unexecuted fails the node.
entries.requirement: Ratification cannot occur before every mandatory gate executes.
entries.source: contract §22; B5-I6 X1 lessons (ledger §17.12-§17.13, corrected audit 8.75/10)

entries.observable_on_rejection: An all-green claim alongside a skipped or pending gate fails the node.
entries.requirement: No 'all gates passed' language is allowed while any gate is skipped, substituted, pending or inferred.
entries.source: contract §22; B5-I6 X1 lessons (ledger §17.12-§17.13, corrected audit 8.75/10)

entries.observable_on_rejection: Any scope statement claiming charter increment I-7, B5-I8 or B5-I9 work as B5-I7 contradicts §1 and is visible in the contract diff.
entries.requirement: B5-I7 is exactly the plan §7 increment 'C4 change cycle plus C5 measurements/learning' and charter increment I-8; no other charter increment is anchored to B5-I7.
entries.source: plan §7 row B5-I7; charter §12 row I-8

entries.observable_on_rejection: A change record naming two or more changes fails the node.
entries.requirement: Exactly one governed change is applied in this stage - 'add a queue-depth observability panel' - and a second change is a violation.
entries.source: charter §12 row I-8; packet §11

binding.command: git diff --name-only --diff-filter=M c6a6479da427ddfe6af06622fc80b2221a4cdc5c -- infrastructure/control-plane/src infrastructure/control-plane/contracts infrastructure/control-plane/tests (output must be empty)

entries.observable_on_rejection: Any modified control-plane source, contract or existing test file makes the diff non-empty.
entries.requirement: infrastructure/control-plane/src/**, infrastructure/control-plane/contracts/** and every pre-existing file under infrastructure/control-plane/tests/** stay byte-identical to the base SHA at every rung.
entries.source: charter §12 I-8 stop column; packet §11; contract §4.3

entries.observable_on_rejection: An added route, job type, schema or extraction artifact is a named boundary violation recorded against §6.
entries.requirement: No scope creep and no platform extraction: no new server endpoint, no new job type, no schema change, no SDK/library extraction, no B6 work.
entries.source: charter §12 I-8 non-goals; plan §9; contract §6

entries.observable_on_rejection: A change record whose intent section is absent, or written after the change, fails the attestation review.
entries.requirement: The change dossier records the intent (the requirement being changed) before implementation begins.
entries.source: plan §5 C4.S5

entries.observable_on_rejection: A plan listing a surface outside the allowed-surface table of contract §5 is rejected.
entries.requirement: The change dossier records the plan and the bounded list of affected surfaces.
entries.source: plan §5 C4.S5

entries.observable_on_rejection: A change with only a positive proof, or with a negative control never executed red, fails the node.
entries.requirement: The change ships with both a positive proof and an executed negative (weakened-implementation) proof.
entries.source: plan §5 C4.S5; contract §21

entries.observable_on_rejection: A manifest that is non-deterministic, or rollback metadata missing base_commit/procedure, is refused.
entries.requirement: Release and rollback for the change are documented and executable: the release manifest is regenerated deterministically and rollback metadata stays complete.
entries.source: plan §5 C4.S5 (release and rollback)

binding.command: git diff --name-only c6a6479da427ddfe6af06622fc80b2221a4cdc5c -- 'docs/oce-golden-system/OCE_B5_I[0-6]*' (output must be empty)

entries.observable_on_rejection: Any frozen prior-stage document differing from the base blob fails the diff check.
entries.requirement: Frozen B5-I0..B5-I6 documents and every prior ledger section stay byte-identical; ledger edits are append-only plus the single §1 status-row update.
entries.source: constitution append-only evidence law; contract §5

entries.observable_on_rejection: Any node-count delta, skip, error or collection difference versus the base run makes the runner assertion fail.
entries.requirement: The control-plane suite passes with a node population identical to the base: zero added, zero removed, zero skipped, zero failed.
entries.source: charter §12 I-8 'control-plane suite passing unchanged'; charter §11 G14

entries.observable_on_rejection: A non-terminal or non-success shared-runner exit makes the gate not executed, never passed.
entries.requirement: The shared authoritative validation runner is green at the exact observed head SHA (no badge inference).
entries.source: charter §11 G14; contract §2

entries.observable_on_rejection: Any byte difference between the reference and rerun drill report fails the identity comparison.
entries.requirement: The regression drill on an unchanged stack produces a byte-identical report to the base-tree reference report.
entries.source: charter §12 I-8 gate column; plan §5 C4.S4

entries.observable_on_rejection: A SHA, run id or artifact id that does not resolve to an existing object/run invalidates the record.
entries.requirement: The governed change record is bound to the observed head SHA, run id and pack blob hash, each recorded only after it exists.
entries.source: charter §12 I-8 evidence column; contract §22

entries.observable_on_rejection: An observation without disposition/owner, or a dropped observation, fails the attestation review.
entries.requirement: Learning ledger entries exist with observation, disposition and owner; no observation is silently discarded.
entries.source: plan §6 C5.S4; charter §12 I-8 evidence column

entries.observable_on_rejection: An undeclared surface that reaches the transport raises ConsoleRefusal with reason unsupported_surface and zero socket attempts.
entries.requirement: The panel requests only surface ids declared in the frozen contract pack; an undeclared, embedded or malformed surface is refused before any I/O.
entries.source: contract pack frozen reads (A12); contract §7

entries.observable_on_rejection: Any POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE attempt or invoke-surface access fails the request-log assertion.
entries.requirement: The panel issues GET requests only and performs no canonical-state write, invoke, lease, requeue or reconciliation action.
entries.source: charter §5 authority law; packet §11

entries.observable_on_rejection: An unreachable stack that yields state OK or any numeric queue value fails the node.
entries.requirement: When the stack is unreachable the panel renders STACK_UNREACHABLE and never a healthy, stale or green value.
entries.source: charter §10 fail-closed law; matrix X4/X7 precedent; contract §13

entries.observable_on_rejection: A missing field rendered as 0 or as green, or a second automatic request after a denial, fails the node.
entries.requirement: Unknown or unverifiable queue values render as null with an explicit unknown_reason (never 0, never green); denials render verbatim; no silent retry.
entries.source: charter §5 rule 9 (verbatim denial); contract §12, §14

entries.observable_on_rejection: Two renders of the same inputs differing in bytes, key order or newline fail the node.
entries.requirement: Identical inputs produce byte-identical canonical panel JSON (sorted keys, ASCII, trailing newline).
entries.source: charter §7 deterministic kernel; contract §9

entries.observable_on_rejection: A non-loopback target that opens a socket fails the blocked-off-loopback control.
entries.requirement: A non-loopback base URL is refused fail-closed before any connection attempt.
entries.source: charter §6 local-only topology; contract §10

entries.observable_on_rejection: Any credential-shaped value in rendered output fails the secret-pattern scan of the node.
entries.requirement: Panel output and evidence artifacts contain no secret, token or authorization material.
entries.source: charter §10 security/privacy; contract §17

entries.observable_on_rejection: An oversized (>64 KiB document / >512-byte argument) or malformed payload accepted without refusal fails the node.
entries.requirement: CLI and document inputs are bounded; oversized or malformed input is refused fail-closed with the frozen refusal vocabulary.
entries.source: contract §11 input bounds

entries.observable_on_rejection: Any changed exit code or failing documented status invocation fails the node.
entries.requirement: The documented 'python -m oce_console status ...' invocation and every documented exit code are unchanged; the panel is strictly additive.
entries.source: charter §8.1 required surface; contract §18 (X3 compatibility)

entries.observable_on_rejection: An unlabelled figure, or an OBSERVED label with no measurement provenance, fails the attestation review.
entries.requirement: Every cost/time figure in the change record carries the label ESTIMATE or OBSERVED, and no unmeasured figure is labelled OBSERVED.
entries.source: plan §6 C5.S1

entries.observable_on_rejection: Any nonzero recurring cost or authority value contradicts the frozen accounting row.
entries.requirement: Recurring cost stays $0 and capital.authority stays none for this stage.
entries.source: charter §13/§15 accounting; plan §7

entries.observable_on_rejection: A claimed reuse item with no import path or executed path is struck from the inventory.
entries.requirement: Each reuse claim in the reuse inventory is verified against a real import or executed runtime path; unverified claims are removed.
entries.source: plan §6 C5.S2; packet §12
